headline: Gestión: How your company's brand suffers due to conflicts over sponsorship – Impact of Trump on Under Armour
subheadline: The effect of Trump’s presidency on sports brands
author: NA
content: 'Having a business-minded president like Donald Trump benefits our country,' commented Kevin Plank, CEO of sportswear giant Under Armour, while speaking to CNBC after his visit to the White House mid February. His response sparked controversy among sponsors and endorsers associated with the brand. Notably, Stephane Curry publicly opposed President Trump despite UA issuing statements against Trump's immigration policies. Johnson also expressed disagreement via Twitter stating those were neither his views nor beliefs but aligned more closely with individuals contributing significantly towards making Under Armour stronger.
